stories.title: Pistons' Ausar Thompson lands 5-year, $155M extension, sources say
stories.summary: Pistons All-Defensive forward Ausar Thompson has agreed to a five-year, $155 million rookie-scale contract extension, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Rams' Donald plans to play; Nacua sits practice
stories.summary: Rams DT Aaron Donald said Friday "the plan" is to play Monday night against the Giants, while WR Puka Nacua did not practice on Friday with a hip issue.

stories.title: Yankees' Judge returning to injured list with calf strain
stories.summary: Three-time AL MVP Aaron Judge is headed back on the injured list -- this time with a right calf strain -- and Yankees manager Aaron Boone isn't sure whether the slugger will be able to return for the postseason.

stories.title: Heat lock up Larsson on 4-year, $60M extension
stories.summary: The Heat and guard Pelle Larsson have reached agreement on a four-year, $60 million extension, his agents told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Mets 1B Young will miss rest of season after collision
stories.summary: New York Mets first baseman Jared Young, 31, who was at home resting and recovering Friday, will miss the rest of the season because of a concussion sustained when he collided with pitcher Nolan McLean while trying to field a ground ball Thursday night.
